events.elaboration_reason: The speaker goes beyond naming the grass fire near the campsite. They describe smoke inside the tent, flames climbing the dry bank and the fear that the fire would reach the campsite. These details make the frightening situation understandable on its own, even though the speaker says they cannot give the full sequence or say who was present.
events.meaning_clarity_reason: The account is easy to follow. The stargazing remark is tied back to the fire, as a contrast between usually looking up at the sky and having attention pulled to the bank and tent. The limits of the speaker's memory are stated plainly rather than causing confusion.
